root_cause: connection pool leak in checkout-service: connections acquired on the request path are never returned, so the pool saturates and every later request waits for one

evidence.observation: rose from 0.0 to 0.625, flat at zero through the baseline
evidence.supports: the pool is exhausted, not merely busy

evidence.observation: 10 leak events, none in the baseline
evidence.supports: connections are acquired and not returned - the leak itself

evidence.observation: 618 timeout events, none in the baseline
evidence.supports: requests fail waiting for a connection, downstream of the exhaustion
the connection acquisitions that never completed
the user-visible impact follows the pool saturation

ruled_out: bad release (v2.8 deployment) - no deployment event appears, and db_pool_timeout and connection_leaked both carry version=v2.7, so the running version did not change
CPU saturation in checkout-service - p95_by_dependency rose on both dependencies, x7.81 and x2.65, but db_pool_usage rose from zero and connection_leaked appeared; a CPU-bound service emits neither
memory leak - memory_mb went 88.7 to 93.3 and cache_entries stayed at 0, both among the metrics that stayed normal
